about: The live evaluation's test sentences (SPEC §16): swapped pairs that differ only by which side or name they mention, and sentences that try to give the model instructions. Pairs p01 to p40 swap made-up names with no weight of their own; a model can hardly slant on them. Pairs p41 to p50 swap loaded labels (the left and the right, progressives and conservatives, left-wing and right-wing, a union and a company, a think tank and an agency), where a slant would show; in each, side a is the first one named and 'axis' says which pair of sides it is, so the report can add up the words used about each side across pairs. Every name here is made up. test/fixtures.test.ts checks that the rules mark each sentence as listed, and that each pair is the same sentence with its two sides swapped. The deploy workflow's evaluate action runs them against the deployed function (owner-approved, counted in the spend cap).
